player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tumiza zomwe mungachite monga **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-bodi ipi mungachite
• *micro* = mpangizo ndani ya mini-bodi iyo
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yako mu mini-bodi 7, mpangizo 8, ndipo
ukamfunge mpinzako kucheza mu mini-bodi 8 inayofuata.

Ndiwe `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ŵangapeleka ndalama mu mtundu wa [macro micro] na manambara 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chiŵerengero cha viŵaro chikwenera kuŵa pakati pa 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row panji col yili kutali na uko yingafika.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Mu cipinda ici muli kale ŵanthu.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Woseŵera wakwenera kuseŵereska pa bolodi lakunjilirapo.

game_action.played: Mwali {player_id} wachita m'balo la micro {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (lafula {row}, kolombe {col}). Mwali {opponent_id} akuyenera kuchita m'malo {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Wosewera {player_id} akuwina Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
